title: Policy Service Desk Note: Copies of a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Certificate
content:
A copy of a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) certificate is issued only while the filing's status is filed. That status is read from the filing record of the certificate asked about.

**Terms of a copy.**

- Copies are free.
- A copy goes only to a recipient on the certificate's list of copy recipients.
- A copy goes only through a channel on its list of copy channels.
- A mailed copy is sent within the certificate's mailing business days.

**Statuses with no copy.** A pending, rejected or cancellation-filed filing gets no copy. For those statuses the desk states the filing's status instead.

| Filing status | Copy issued | Desk response |
|---|---|---|
| filed | yes | copy issued on the terms above |
| requested (pending) | no | the desk states the status |
| rejected | no | the desk states the status |
| cancellation-filed | no | the desk states the status |
| terminated | no | |
| withdrawn | no | |

**Hypothetical.** A certificate that received its SR-26 last week is cancellation-filed, so no copy is issued; the desk states that status. The fact that the state still treats the driver as certified until the certificate end date does not change the status.
